checkpoint.description: Surface every semantic WorkingCheckpoint before completion.

fixed60m.description: Surface at most once per 60 minutes while active, plus completion.
fixed60m.expectedCost: may review stale/wrong hypotheses or delay abrupt falsifiers

eventTriggeredV1.description: Surface before completion only when at least one frozen trigger is met.

promotionRule: Do not promote eventTriggeredV1 unless prospective tasks show lower interruption load than checkpoint policy without materially worse critical-event recall/correction cost, and it is not dominated by fixed60m.
